businesses.business: welding and cutting equipment and consumables

offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures welding and cutting equipment, filler metals and consumables, and gas control equipment. Sells to industrial fabricators, construction, energy, shipbuilding and infrastructure customers, mainly through distributors and direct sales.

primary_products.value: welding equipment; welding consumables and filler metals; plasma cutting systems; gas control regulators; automated welding and cutting systems

primary_services.value: equipment repair and maintenance; training; digital welding software and fleet management services

customer_segment.value: B2B: industrial fabricators, contractors, OEMs, shipyards, energy and infrastructure firms, welding supply customers

end_markets.value: general fabrication; construction and infrastructure; energy; shipbuilding; transportation; medical and life sciences

revenue_model.value: product sales: welding machines, consumables, cutting systems and gas control equipment; service fees: repair, maintenance, training and software services

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: manufactures welding and cutting equipment and consumables from purchased metals and components, sold to distributors and industrial users

geography_served.value: global: Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa and Asia-Pacific, including India and China

specialization.value: related lines: welding equipment, consumables, cutting systems and gas control products sharing customers and channels

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: independent welding supply distributors and dealers; direct sales: large industrial accounts and OEMs; online: e-commerce for consumables and equipment

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: product safety standards, environmental and workplace safety rules, trade and tariff regulations
